[[File:Gorilla in the Mist menu.jpg|thumb|300px]] '''Gorilla in the Mist''' is a [[Fog of War]] mission featuring [[Optimus Primal]] as the boss that ran from June 24th to July 1st, 2021. It returned on October 27, 2022 and ran for the remainder of the game's life.

==Synopsis==
''The multiverses are still open and Beast Bots are spilling in from all over. There are reports that a leader of these dangerous animals is deep within the latest Fog Of War and it's up to the Commander to see if they can capture the GORILLA IN THE MIST!''

Mods: Ranged Timed 1-4, Stagger 2-4

== Transcript ==
Intro

* [[Marissa Faireborn]]: Commander, there is reports of wild beasts somewhere in the fog, With all this multiverse madness I would advise you to stay on high alert.
* We can't be sure who's friend or foe out there...all I've been hearing is howls and growls. Best of luck.

Boss

* Optimus Primal: POACHER! YOU DARE FACE THE POWER OF PRIMAL AGAIN!?
* I MAY NOT KNOW WHERE I AM. OR WHO YOU ARE. OR WHAT IS GOING ON!
* BUT I KNOW THAT IF YOU ARE LOOKING FOR A FIGHT ... THAT'S JUST PRIME!

==Rewards==

=== Chapter 1 - T1 - Lowland ===

* Energy: 3/Node
* Rating: 3,030
* Completion Rewards: 40 T1 Essence, all classes
* Node Rewards: ~140 Gold, 5 T1 Essence all classes, +10 for class of defeated bot
* Boss Rewards: ~260 Gold, 20 T1 Essence all classes, +20 for class of defeated bot

=== Chapter 2 - T2 - River ===

* Energy: 4/Node
* Rating: 6,060
* Completion Rewards: 140 T2 Essence, all classes
* Node Rewards: ~440 Gold, 25 T2 Essence all classes, +10 for class of defeated bot
* Boss Rewards: ~860 Gold, 100 T2 Essence all classes, +40 for class of defeated bot

=== Chapter 3 - T3 - Mountain ===

* Energy: 5/Node
* Rating: 12,875
* Completion Rewards: 240 T3 Essence, all classes
* Node Rewards: 740-745 Gold, 40 T3 Essence all classes, +20 for class of defeated bot
* Boss Rewards: 1,470-1475 Gold, 160 T3 Essence, +80 for class of defeated bot 

=== Chapter 4 - T4 - Silverback ===

* Energy: 6/Node
* Rating: 23,720
* Completion Rewards: 80 T4 Essence, all classes
* Node Rewards: 1,225-1,240 Gold, 10 T4 Essence all classes, +10 for class of defeated bot
* Boss Rewards: 2,450-2,460 Gold, 40 T4 Essence all classes, +40 for class of defeated bot
